messages:
Nina (CSM): Kicking off Aegis onboarding. Primary goals: secure baseline integration and first internal demo by day 12. Quick sync today at 3pm PT?

Jon (Solutions Eng): I’ll cover routing + model choice. Need expected concurrency and sample payloads.

Martin (Customer): We’re aiming for 800 req/day initially, up to 3r/s peak. I’ll upload sample prompts + JSON schema later today.

Priya (Enablement): I can run a 45m enablement: console walkthrough, key rotation, alerting. Proposed Thu 9am PT.

Martin (Customer): Thu 9am PT works. Also we need retention details for audit logs (90d) and SSO guide.

Nina (CSM): Draft success criteria (day 12): 1) Prod API call flow with >=3k tokens sent; 2) p95 latency <600ms; 3) Demo with PMs + sign-off. Owners: Integration=Martin/Jon, Observability=Priya, Security=Me.

Jon (Solutions Eng): Recommend hosted with autoscale for first 30 days, enable prefix KV cache + batching. I’ll post runtime snippet after sync.

onboard-bot: Reminder: complete pre-onboard checklist https://forms.redwood.ai/aegis by Wed 5pm PT

Nina (CSM): Risks logged: SSO timing, audit retention export, and potential perf hit at peak. Escalation path: tag #release-war-room.

Priya (Enablement): Invite sent with slides + quickstart. Sharing Splunk/forwarding config in the channel after the call.

Martin (Customer): Sending prompts now. Thanks everyone.

Jon (Solutions Eng): config snippet:
```
model: rw-4b
batching: enabled
kv_cache: prefix
latency_target_ms: 600
monitoring: p95/prometheus, audit=forward
```

Nina (CSM): I’ll create tasks in Asana and set a day-4 check-in. :thumbsup:
